best_for: Windows users who remove programs often and want the leftover folders and registry entries cleared too, without paying for the Pro edition.

points.title: Uninstall, then sweep
points.text: Revo first runs the program's own uninstaller, then scans for files, folders and registry entries it left behind and offers to delete them.

points.title: Hunter Mode
points.text: Drag a target icon onto a program's window, desktop shortcut or tray icon to uninstall it or stop it from starting with Windows, handy when you don't know its name.

points.title: Eight extra tools
points.text: The free edition also removes built-in Windows apps and includes cleaners such as an Autorun Manager, a junk file cleaner and an unrecoverable delete.

points.title: Forced uninstall is Pro
points.text: Removing programs whose uninstaller is broken or missing needs Pro, which costs USD 24.95 for one year or USD 39.95 for two. The license keeps working after the update period ends. Prices were read on the date below.

points.title: Runs on old PCs
points.text: The free edition supports 32-bit and 64-bit Windows 7 through 11 and Windows Server, with 512 MB of RAM.

points.title: Installer or portable
points.text: The installer listed here installs for all users, and the Windows listing keeps 3 versions. A free portable zip is also offered on the vendor's site. Revo is freeware, not open source.
